title: EmailComparator missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/query.rs line 131, EmailComparator is a public struct without #[non_exhaustive]. RFC 8620 §5.5 or a future RFC extension could add new comparator fields (e.g. locale, position-based tie-breaking). Without #[non_exhaustive], adding any field is semver-breaking. Consistent with finding JMAP-u2e.3 — the pattern in this codebase is to mark public data structs #[non_exhaustive].
